cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

# Setup compiler settings
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME stm32workspace)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})
message("Build type: " ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})

enable_language(C ASM)

add_executable(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

# Use the exact source list generated by STM32CubeMX. Do not recursively
# compile the complete Drivers/CMSIS tree, which contains tests, examples,
# templates, and sources for unrelated Arm cores.
add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)

target_link_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user-defined library search paths here.
)

target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    Core/Src/ssd1306_simple.c
    App/Src/xbox_protocol.c
    App/Src/motor.c
    App/Src/ultrasonic.c
    App/Src/safety_controller.c
    App/Src/diagnostics.c
    App/Src/control_system.c
    Board/Src/board_runtime.c
)

target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    App/Inc
    Board/Inc
)

target_compile_options(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    -Wall
    -Wextra
    -Wpedantic
    -Wshadow
    -Wconversion
    -Wsign-conversion
)

target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add project-owned symbols here.
)

option(XBOXCAR_ENABLE_ULTRASONIC
    "Enable four HC-SR04 inputs after fitting 3.3 V level shifting" OFF)
if(XBOXCAR_ENABLE_ULTRASONIC)
    target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        APP_FEATURE_ULTRASONIC=1)
endif()

# Remove a spurious libob.a dependency when C++ files are enabled.
list(REMOVE_ITEM CMAKE_C_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES ob)

target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    stm32cubemx
)
# Produce programmer-ready artifacts next to the ELF after every firmware build.
if(NOT CMAKE_OBJCOPY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The ARM toolchain did not provide CMAKE_OBJCOPY")
endif()
add_custom_command(TARGET ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O ihex
        "$<TARGET_FILE:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>"
        "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>/$<TARGET_FILE_BASE_NAME:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>.hex"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary
        "$<TARGET_FILE:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>"
        "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>/$<TARGET_FILE_BASE_NAME:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>.bin"
    VERBATIM
)

find_program(POWERSHELL_EXECUTABLE NAMES pwsh powershell REQUIRED)

# Normal automatic programming path.
add_custom_target(flash
    COMMAND ${POWERSHELL_EXECUTABLE}
        -NoProfile
        -ExecutionPolicy Bypass
        -File ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/flash.ps1
        -ElfPath $<TARGET_FILE:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    USES_TERMINAL
    VERBATIM
)

# Four-wire ST-Link path with no NRST connection. Start this target, press
# RESET until programming begins, then press RESET once more after success.
add_custom_target(recover-flash
    COMMAND ${POWERSHELL_EXECUTABLE}
        -NoProfile
        -ExecutionPolicy Bypass
        -File ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/recover-and-flash.ps1
        -ElfPath $<TARGET_FILE:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    USES_TERMINAL
    VERBATIM
)
